passages.S04.title: S04 · Igbo traditional wedding, guest
passages.S04.context: She is 29, from Enugu, a friend of the bride. The two families wear coral red and wine. She has not bought aso-ebi.
passages.S04-A: A gown in cord lace, emerald. An ichafu in a matching tone. Gold earrings. Embellished heels. A clutch.
